infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Breeze uses the camera to scan food barcodes and labels, photograph meals to count calories, and check your exercise form.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Breeze turns what you say into text so the coach can understand your answers.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Breeze uses the microphone so you can answer the coach out loud.
